steps: Plug the coax cable into your new modem and power it on. Wait 5–10 minutes for the lights to go solid.
On your phone, go to xfinity.com/activate and sign in.
Follow the prompts to register your modem (you'll need the MAC address from the sticker on the modem).
Wait for the confirmation, then restart the modem once more.
